description: Test helper functions for creating mock plugin registries, adding hooks, and creating hook runners in a plugin system.

methods.name: createMockPluginRegistry
methods.description: Creates a mock plugin registry with specified hooks for testing.

methods.name: addTestHook
methods.description: Adds a single test hook to the plugin registry.

methods.name: addTestHooks
methods.description: Adds multiple test hooks to the plugin registry.

methods.name: addStaticTestHooks
methods.description: Adds static test hooks with predefined results to the registry.

methods.name: createHookRunnerWithRegistry
methods.description: Creates a hook runner with a mock plugin registry for testing.
